title: FVD Brombacher - K16/24 Hybrid Sport Turbocharger for 993
notes: Supplier describes a K16/24 hybrid with a 47.5 mm compressor-wheel inlet, extended-tip compressor, CNC-reprofiled housing, modified backplate, strengthened thrust bearing and trimmed turbine. The standard wastegate pressure actuator is retained; the earlier vacuum-actuator wording is superseded by the 2026-10-02 product-page review. The 555 hp claim requires FVD software, intercoolers and supporting tuning components. High-speed core balancing up to 100,000 rpm is a balancing condition, not an operating-speed limit. Product envelope 290 x 230 x 230 mm and mass 5.63 kg are supplier declarations, not OEM wheel geometry. Oil-line adapters may be required. No compressor/turbine map or complete wheel alloy/geometry is published.
